subject: Not able to update Dropbox file through shinyapps.io

messages.author: 89d22d60a6f9509f
messages.subject: Not able to update Dropbox file through shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

I am creating an app where I want the results to be saved in a file in Dropbox.
When I run the app through RStudio, everything works fine. But through shinyapps.io, the Dropbox is not updated.
I am not referring to any local path, which might be preventing it.
Can anyone please help me with this.

Below is the code snippet-

fileName<-"responses.csv"
  outputDir <- "responses"
  write.table(x = data, file = file.path(fileName),append = TRUE,
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE, col.names =F) 
 
  token <- readRDS("token.rds")
  drop_acc(dtoken = token) 
  drop_upload(fileName, path = outputDir, mode = "overwrite", dtoken = token)
